metadata.description: Stateful agent runtime for Prime Intellect

runtime.description: Core agent execution engine built on async/await EventStream
features: EventStream-based streaming response handling with Symbol.asyncIterator
Async iterator consumer pattern for event consumption
Parallel tool execution mode (default): preflight sequentially, execute concurrently, emit tool_execution_end in completion order
Sequential tool execution mode: execute one tool at a time, blocking
Per-tool executionMode override: sequential forces entire batch to run one at a time
Abort signal propagation throughout all async operations
raceWithAbort utility for cancelling operations on abort signal
maybePromiseWithAbort for wrapping sync/async ops with abort tracking
Retry with backoff via maxRetryDelayMs option
Tool streaming via onUpdate callback (AgentToolUpdateCallback)
Early termination hint via terminate flag on tool results
Mixed terminate results: loop only stops when ALL tool results in batch set terminate=true
Steering queue: PendingMessageQueue with 'all' and 'one-at-a-time' modes
Follow-up queue: PendingMessageQueue with 'all' and 'one-at-a-time' modes
shouldStopBeforeTurn hook (sync, checked before each turn's LLM call)
shouldStopAfterTurn hook (async, checked after turn_end, before polling queues)
getSteeringMessages: poll steering messages after each turn completes
getFollowUpMessages: poll follow-up messages after tool calls finish and steering is empty
getContinuationMessages: host-owned continuation policy (e.g., long-running goals)
lastTurn context capture passed to getContinuationMessages
Full run lifecycle: agent_start -> turn_start -> message_start/update/end -> turn_end -> agent_end
Low-level agentLoop() and agentLoopContinue() functions for direct control
Stream wrapper (createAgentStream) using EventStream with agent_end as terminal event
Partial message reconstruction client-side during streaming
Graceful abort: finishAbortedMessage creates final assistant message with stopReason=aborted
Error message tracking: agent stores most recent errorMessage in state
isStreaming state tracking: true during any run including awaited agent_end listeners
pendingToolCalls tracking via Set<string>

model_support.description: Delegates to @earendil-works/pi-ai for model abstraction. Generic Model<any> type used throughout.
features: Generic Model<any> from @earendil-works/pi-ai (no hardcoded model families)
DefaultModel fallback: {id:'unknown', name:'unknown', api:'unknown', provider:'unknown'}
Transport abstraction (Transport type from pi-ai) for switching HTTP backends
ThinkingLevel enum: 'off' | 'minimal' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max'
xhigh and max levels noted as model-family-specific (checked via model metadata)
ServiceTier support (ServiceTier type from pi-ai): 'default' tier by default
ThinkingBudgets map for token-based providers: { minimal, low, medium, high } token counts
streamSimple as default stream function (from pi-ai)
Custom streamFn override for proxy or alternative backends
Session ID passed through for provider-side caching
Provider-specific cacheRetention option

tools.description: Full tool lifecycle: prepare -> validate -> before hook -> execute -> after hook -> result
features: AgentTool interface extending Tool<TParameters> from pi-ai with label, execute, prepareArguments, executionMode
Typebox TSchema for parameter validation via validateToolArguments
prepareArguments shim: allows tools to normalize raw arguments before schema validation
execute signature: (toolCallId, params, signal?, onUpdate?) => Promise<AgentToolResult<TDetails>>
onUpdate callback: (partialResult) => void for streaming progress from tools
AgentToolResult: { content: (TextContent|ImageContent)[], details: T, terminate?: boolean }
AgentToolUpdateCallback<T>: callback type for partial tool result updates
beforeToolCall hook: runs after args validated, before execute. Can block with {block: true, reason?}
afterToolCall hook: runs after execute, before tool_execution_end. Can override content, details, isError, terminate
Per-tool executionMode: 'sequential' | 'parallel' (overrides global toolExecution)
Parallel execution: Promise.all over finalized call entries after concurrent execution
Sequential execution: for-of loop with await between each tool call
Immediate tool result: when blocked or tool not found, return result without execution
Tool not found: returns error tool result with message 'Tool {name} not found'
Argument validation error: caught and returned as immediate error tool result
Error-thrown by tool execute: caught, reported as isError=true tool result
Abort during tool: caught, returns 'Tool execution aborted' error result
terminate hint: only respected when every tool in batch returns it
tool_execution_start event: emitted with toolCallId, toolName, args
tool_execution_update event: emitted for each partial result from onUpdate callback
tool_execution_end event: emitted with toolCallId, toolName, result, isError (in completion order for parallel)
toolResult message: role='toolResult', includes toolCallId, toolName, content, details, isError, timestamp

session.description: Basic session support for provider caching. No built-in state persistence to disk.
features: sessionId option on Agent (string, passed to provider for caching)
Session ID propagated to stream options via AgentLoopConfig.sessionId
No built-in session persistence (stateless between runs)
waitForIdle(): Promise<void> — resolves when activeRun completes and agent_end listeners settle
reset(): clears messages, streaming state, pending tool calls, error, and all queues
activeRun tracking: { promise, resolve, abortController } for run lifecycle
busy check: continue() throws AgentContinueError{code:'busy'} if activeRun exists
nothing-to-continue error when last message role is assistant or no messages exist

context.description: AgentMessage as first-class type with transformContext and convertToLlm bridging to LLM Message
features: AgentMessage: union of Message (from pi-ai) + CustomAgentMessages (extensible via declaration merging)
Default convertToLlm: filters to role=user|assistant|toolResult only
Custom convertToLlm: required when using custom message types
transformContext: optional async transform before convertToLlm (for pruning, injection)
AgentContext snapshot: { systemPrompt, messages: AgentMessage[], tools }
createContextSnapshot(): returns deep copy of current state
Context messages array copied at each loop iteration (immutable pattern)
System prompt resolution via getSystemPrompt callback (called per LLM call)
getApiKey callback: dynamic API key resolution per provider per LLM call
PendingMessageQueue for steering and follow-up batches
Queue drain modes: 'all' (flat and clear) vs 'one-at-a-time' (FIFO batch)
Queue removeWhere: remove messages matching predicate, return removed messages
hasQueuedMessages(): check if steering or follow-up queue has items
Custom message extension via declaration merging (CustomAgentMessages interface)
Example in docs: notification message type added via module augmentation

subagent.description: No built-in subagent spawning or parallel agent instances. Single-agent execution model.
features: NO built-in subagent spawning or agent tree management
Single-agent execution: one agent loop per Agent instance
getContinuationMessages hook: allows host to inject continuation messages (external subagent coordination point)
getSteeringMessages hook: allows host to inject steering messages (external agent coordination point)
getFollowUpMessages hook: allows host to queue follow-up (external coordination point)
No native parallel prompt handling — must manage multiple Agent instances externally

event.description: Rich event system covering run, turn, message, and tool execution lifecycle
features: AgentEvent union type with all event variants
agent_start: emitted once at start of run (no payload)
agent_end: emitted once at end of run, carries messages: AgentMessage[] — terminal event for EventStream
turn_start: emitted before each LLM call
turn_end: emitted after LLM call and tool execution, carries message and toolResults[]
message_start: emitted for any message beginning (user, assistant, toolResult)
message_update: emitted only for assistant messages during streaming, carries assistantMessageEvent
message_update assistantMessageEvent types: text_start, text_delta, text_end, thinking_start, thinking_delta, thinking_end, toolcall_start, toolcall_delta, toolcall_end
message_end: emitted for any message completion
tool_execution_start: emitted with toolCallId, toolName, args
tool_execution_update: emitted with toolCallId, toolName, args, partialResult
tool_execution_end: emitted with toolCallId, toolName, result, isError (in completion order for parallel)
Agent.subscribe(listener): registers event handler, returns unsubscribe function
Listeners awaited in subscription order, included in run settlement
Listeners receive AbortSignal for current run
agent_end listeners: must settle before agent becomes idle
abort signal passed to every listener callback
No event batching or throttling — immediate sequential emission

persistence.description: In-memory state only. No built-in persistence. State access via accessor pattern.
features: AgentState: in-memory only, no automatic persistence
state.tools getter/setter with array copy on assignment (defensive copy)
state.messages getter/setter with array copy on assignment
streamFn, getApiKey, convertToLlm, transformContext, beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, shouldStopAfterTurn, shouldStopBeforeTurn, getContinuationMessages: all public properties on Agent class
isStreaming: readonly, true during any run including awaited agent_end listeners
streamingMessage: partial assistant message during streaming
pendingToolCalls: ReadonlySet<string> of executing tool call IDs
errorMessage: most recent error or aborted reason from assistant turn
reset(): clears in-memory state only, no file/disk operations
No session save/load — caller must implement persistence externally

config.description: Two-level config: AgentOptions (public API) and AgentLoopConfig (internal loop interface)
features: AgentOptions: initialState, convertToLlm, transformContext, streamFn, getApiKey, onPayload, onResponse, beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, shouldStopAfterTurn, shouldStopBeforeTurn, getContinuationMessages, steeringMode, followUpMode, sessionId, thinkingBudgets, transport, maxRetryDelayMs, toolExecution
AgentLoopConfig extends SimpleStreamOptions from pi-ai
ThinkingLevel: 'off'|'minimal'|'low'|'medium'|'high'|'xhigh'|'max' (xhigh/max model-family-dependent)
ToolExecutionMode: 'sequential' | 'parallel' (default: parallel)
QueueMode: 'all' | 'one-at-a-time' (default for steering and follow-up: one-at-a-time)
Transport: from pi-ai, 'auto' by default on Agent
ThinkingBudgets: { minimal: number, low: number, medium: number, high: number }
maxRetryDelayMs: number for retry backoff cap
onPayload: SimpleStreamOptions['onPayload'] — called with raw request payload
onResponse: SimpleStreamOptions['onResponse'] — called with raw response
Agent state mutability: systemPrompt, model, thinkingLevel, serviceTier mutable via state setters

Agent public properties mutable after construction: convertToLlm, transformContext, streamFn, getApiKey, onPayload, onResponse, beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, shouldStopAfterTurn, shouldStopBeforeTurn, getContinuationMessages, sessionId, thinkingBudgets, transport, maxRetryDelayMs, toolExecution
AgentLoopConfig.getSystemPrompt: () => string — called per LLM call for dynamic system prompt
AgentLoopConfig.getApiKey: (provider) => string|undefined — called per LLM call
AgentLoopConfig.getSteeringMessages: () => AgentMessage[] — called after each turn
AgentLoopConfig.getFollowUpMessages: () => AgentMessage[] — called when no more tool calls
AgentLoopConfig.getContinuationMessages: (context, signal) => AgentMessage[] — called when no follow-ups

auth.description: Dynamic API key resolution per provider, plus proxy authentication token
features: getApiKey callback: (provider: string) => string|undefined|Promise — resolved per LLM call
Useful for short-lived OAuth tokens (e.g., GitHub Copilot) that expire during execution
getApiKey must not throw — returns undefined when no key available
apiKey on AgentLoopConfig: fallback static key if getApiKey not provided
Proxy auth: streamProxy takes explicit authToken (Bearer token) separate from model apiKey
Proxy auth sent as Authorization: Bearer {authToken} header
No built-in credential storage or env var reading
No automatic provider detection — caller must provide getApiKey or config.apiKey

plugin.description: No explicit plugin system. Extensibility via options, hooks, and custom message types.
features: No plugin/extension architecture — no hooks into core lifecycle
Extensibility via options: all hooks are public Agent properties set at construction or anytime after
Extensible AgentMessage via declaration merging: CustomAgentMessages interface
No registry or plugin discovery mechanism
Proxy stream function (streamProxy) as optional backend alternative via streamFn option
Low-level agentLoop() and agentLoopContinue() for callers who want full control without Agent class
Custom message types: caller extends CustomAgentMessages via module augmentation
No built-in tool registry — tools are passed as AgentTool[] array to state
